seen.where: Archive description only: EAD of toegang 383 (Vrijmetselaarsloge La Flamboyante) from harvest.archieven.nl OAI-PMH, GetRecord identifier E15A1476101948B49EC9DCBCCB34A252, read 16 Nov 2026: inv. 847 'Aantekeningen in geheimschrift, z.j', 1 stuk, normal date 1812/2000; inv. 803 'Stukken betreffende het maconniek geheimschrift, z.j', 1 omslag.
seen.extent: Inv. 847 is one piece of notes; inv. 803 is one folder of papers on the Masonic secret writing. Leaf counts are not given and no images exist online.
seen.cipher: The archive itself calls inv. 847 notes written in 'geheimschrift' (cipher, secret writing). The type is not described; in a lodge archive it is most probably the Masonic pigpen alphabet. Not seen here.

vetting.closed: Closed as read: the RGAVMF record files the decipherments ('расшифровки') with Cromariot's ciphered telegrams of 1904, so the texts were read at the time; whether every telegram has its decipherment is not shown.
